description: This file defines a function to extract audio-related tags from text, specifically handling directives like [[audio_as_voice]] for voice messages. It supports parsing inline directives and returns an object indicating the presence of an audio tag, whether the audio should be sent as voice, and the processed text.

methods.name: export function parseAudioTag(text?: string): { parseAudioTag
methods.description: Extracts audio mode tags from a given text, supporting inline directives like [[audio_as_voice]], and returns an object with processed text, a flag for voice mode, and whether a tag was present.
